title: make-regs.py: Minor improvments suggested by Git-Hub Copilot
description:
Summary of changes:
•	Added imports: os, tempfile.
•	scan_files now skips non-files, reads with encoding='utf-8-sig', errors='replace', and warns on read errors.
•	@filelist parsing filters blank lines and comments and reads with utf-8-sig.
•	Each maker function deduplicates found names deterministically (preserves order) before sorting.
•	Fixed the error message in make_event_dissectors to reference event registrations.
•	Output files are written atomically using a temporary file in the target directory and replace,
        with UTF-8 encoding and error handling.
•	Updated usage string to include all supported modes.

AI-Assisted: yes [Git-Hub Copilot]

notes.body: What does it mean if there were duplicates?  Is that an error and reason to stop?
Not sure, but there shouldn't be any register routines with the same name.
